patterns.note: Storybook-style framing where large, custom-illustrated trees and ground layers anchor the top and bottom of the page, sandwiching the structured content.
A natural, education-focused palette combining a soft mint-green canvas with deep forest-green containers, accented by vibrant primary yellow and bright green CTAs.
Irregular, hand-drawn display typography for headings that mimics chalkboard writing, paired with clean, highly legible geometric sans-serif body text.
A dedicated 'math notebook' testimonial section featuring a green graph-paper background, hand-drawn mathematical doodles, and scattered, slightly rotated polaroid-style video cards.
The page relies on static illustrative hierarchy for its main structure, complemented by subtle CSS keyframe animations on interactive elements and hover states on cards.

technique_notes: Recreate the whimsical hero by layering a transparent-background character illustration over a rich, full-bleed landscape background, ensuring text remains highly legible on the left.
Build the testimonial grid using a CSS grid container over a repeating SVG graph-paper pattern, applying slight CSS transforms (rotate) to individual video cards to create an organic, scattered look.
Implement CSS keyframe animations to give subtle, continuous motion to illustrated elements, making the mascot characters feel alive without distracting from the core value proposition.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, playful hand-drawn display headings (~4x body size) contrasted with clean, medium-weight geometric body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded, featuring pill-shaped navigation bars and buttons alongside moderately rounded cards to maintain a friendly, child-safe aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, utilizing generous vertical padding to let large-scale illustrations breathe while keeping functional grids tight and organized.

standout: The seamless integration of high-quality, custom storybook illustrations and a recurring cat mascot with highly structured, professional SaaS-style UI components like tabbed tutor profiles and clean pricing matrices.
